name: clef-verify
description: Before Claude ends a turn that changed files, has Cloudflare's Clairic extraction model read the command output and the Clef decision model check that the work is shown to be done (tests run and passing where needed, claims backed by the steps, nothing asked for left undone), and sends Claude back if not.

accountId.title: Cloudflare Account ID
accountId.description: The account whose Workers AI runs Clef and Clairic. Falls back to the CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID environment variable.

apiToken.title: Cloudflare API Token
apiToken.description: A token with Workers AI read permission, kept in secure storage. Falls back to the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN environment variable.

model.title: Clef model
model.description: The decision model that judges the turn: clef (27B, most accurate), clef-flash (9B, fastest and cheapest) or clef-omni (30B mixture-of-experts).

extractor.title: Extraction model
extractor.description: clairic: before Clef judges, Clairic reads the output of the commands run after the last change and extracts the check commands, test counts and failures, which Clef reads and the send-back quotes. off: Clef reads the output alone.

threshold.title: Send-back threshold
threshold.description: Send Claude back when Clef is at least this sure (0 to 1) that something is missing.

maxRetries.title: Most send-backs per prompt
maxRetries.description: How many times Claude can be sent back for one of your prompts; after that the turn ends and a toast says what Clef still found missing.
